notes.title: Witchy Business v1.0.2 - Fixes & Enhancements
notes.notes:
We’ve brewed up a fresh patch with some fixes and improvements to keep your witchy shop running smoother!

[h2]Changes & Fixes[/h2]
• Fixed various inventory visual issues  
• Expanded certain hitboxes for smoother interactions  
• Save file compatibility between demo and full version is being checked  
• Synced translations for better consistency  
• Greatly reduced the chance of slime cat getting hungry  
• Enabled Steam Cloud Save
• Fixed: Maxed out Santuary and Shop not triggering the achievements

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
As always, thank you for playing and supporting Witchy Business. Your feedback helps us polish every spell, shelf, and pawstep in the game. 💜

notes.title: Witchy Business v0.7.0 - Demo Update
notes.notes:
The cauldron's bubbling and the familiars are purring—our magical shop just got a fresh batch of updates! Thanks to your feedback and some hard work behind the scenes, the demo has been sprinkled with all sorts of improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[b]✨ New Features & Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*]5 new customers are added,
[*]Mean Spirit is added, it drains your reputation until you clean all the goo around it,
[*]Orders & inventory panels are now combined,
[*]An arrow indicator for fortune telling minigame is added to help you find the strongest aura position of the customer,
[*]Wand making minigame is updated, wand cleaning and gem placing steps are added,
[*]Color of the liquid in the cauldron now changes based on ingredients & potions,
[*]Both Cat in Slime variations now need to be fed after cleaning all the slime,
[*]Tutorial scenario is updated & more arrow indicators are added for clarity,
[*]A confirmation panel for unlocking new farming patches is added,
[*]Familiar hunger process is updated, you now have 20 seconds to feed your familiar after it wakes up
[/list]

Plus, plenty of tweaks, polish, and fixes across the board to improve your witchy workflow.  
Thanks for playing and keep that broomstick handy—there’s more magic to come! ✨
